heading: Raped, stabbed 8 times, body dumped: Delhi teen goes to meet friend, he calls 3 others
author: TNN / Updated: Sep 18, 2026, 14:07 IST
paragraphs: NEW DELHI: A 16-year-old girl was raped and murdered, allegedly by a group of four youths, in Outer Delhi’s Swaroop Nagar and her body dumped in an open field
Three minors and a 19-year-old man have been apprehended in connection with the case.Police said three of the suspects allegedly raped the girl
The fourth suspect claimed he was not involved in the sexual assault but participated in the murder
Investigators are verifying his claim and examining the individual role of each suspect.The incident took place on Sept 12
Police received information about a body lying near an open field along Kushak Road the following morning
A team reached the spot and found the body, whose identity was initially unknown

The girl had been stabbed at least eight times.Based on preliminary investigation, police registered an FIR under sections 103(1) (murder), 238(A) (causing disappearance of evidence or giving false information to screen an offender), 65(1) (rape) and 3(5) (common intention) of BNS, along with Section 6 of Pocso Act.DCP (Outer North) Shobhit D Saksena formed a dedicated team under the supervision of additional DCP Lokeshwaran R
With no apparent eyewitness and the identities of the suspects unknown, investigators relied on CCTV footage from the area
More than 50 cameras covering the crime spot and adjoining routes were examined.During the analysis, police noticed a tempo moving near the area around the suspected time of the crime
However, its registration number could not be clearly identified due to darkness
Investigators subsequently tracked the vehicle across multiple CCTV locations and matched its movements with field enquiries

This helped police establish the suspected vehicle’s route and identify it.A night-long search operation was conducted during the intervening night of Sept 15 and 16, following which the tempo was traced parked in Khadda Colony, Swaroop Nagar
Police identified and questioned the driver, leading to the apprehension of the four suspects.According to police, on Sept 12, the girl had gone to meet a friend

He allegedly called his friends, following which they travelled in a goods-carrying tempo operated by the brother of one of the minors.During questioning, the suspects told police that they had been drinking
Police said the suspects sexually assaulted the girl inside the tempo before stabbing her multiple times
Fearing that she would report the forceful assault, they allegedly killed her

Police said the account given by the suspects is being verified, and forensic and other evidence is being examined.Two knives allegedly used in the crime and the clothes allegedly worn by the suspects have been recovered
